svg.title: PURGATORY Weapon Side master v1
svg.desc: Weapon paper-doll sheet. 1024×1024 px · 256 px/wu · pivot (512, 512) is the weapon visual origin and GripFront. Draw weapon pixels around that +. REFERENCE_HAND_DO_NOT_EXPORT and REFERENCE_CHARACTER_DO_NOT_EXPORT are guide art and must not be exported into the weapon PNG.
